categories.name: Software Development
categories.intro: Installed and cloud software for the day-to-day work of a business: billing, stock, clinics, schools, factories and more. Each solution below is a starting point that we adapt to your industry and way of working.
categories.custom_text: We develop all types of customized software solutions tailored to your industry, business operations and specific requirements, including desktop, cloud-based, offline and hybrid applications.

categories.name: Web Application Development
categories.intro: Browser-based applications that teams and customers sign in to from any device: CRM, HR, ERP, learning, booking and analytics platforms, built secure and ready to grow.
categories.custom_text: We build secure, scalable and fully customized web applications for businesses of all sizes, with advanced functionalities, administrative dashboards and third-party integrations.

categories.name: Mobile Application Development
categories.intro: Android and iOS apps for businesses, communities and individual users: attendance, field work, booking, learning, shopping, finance and more.
categories.custom_text: We develop all types of Android and iOS applications tailored to business requirements, individual users and industry-specific needs.

categories.name: Website Development
categories.intro: Websites designed for the way each industry sells, informs and takes enquiries: ten industry categories and ten website types, each customised to the business behind it.
categories.custom_text: We design and develop websites for all types of businesses and industries, with customized designs, functionalities, administrative controls and third-party integrations based on customer requirements.

types.name: Static Websites
types.text: Fast, simple sites with fixed pages, ideal when content rarely changes.

types.name: Dynamic Websites
types.text: Sites whose content comes from a database and can be updated without code.

types.name: Corporate Websites
types.text: Multi-page company sites with services, team, insights and careers.

types.name: E-commerce Websites
types.text: Online stores with catalogue, cart, payments and order handling.

types.name: Portfolio Websites
types.text: Visual showcases for creative professionals, studios and freelancers.

types.name: Landing Pages
types.text: Single-purpose pages built to turn a campaign visit into an enquiry.

types.name: CMS-Based Websites
types.text: Sites with an admin panel so your team edits pages, images and posts.

types.name: AI-Powered Websites
types.text: Sites with AI features such as assistants or smart search, scoped with you and built where it is useful.

types.name: Interactive Websites
types.text: Sites with calculators, configurators, quizzes and other interactive tools.

types.name: 3D Animated Websites
types.text: Visually rich sites using 3D and animation, designed to stay fast on ordinary devices.

categories.name: Headless SaaS & API Solutions
categories.intro: Reusable backend services that your applications call instead of rebuilding: sign-in, messaging, documents, codes, recognition and conversation.
categories.custom_text: We develop customized APIs, backend services, headless SaaS platforms and integration solutions based on business and application requirements.

categories.name: AI Agents & Business Automation
categories.intro: Planned AI agents and intelligent assistants for front-desk, support, sales, HR and document work (under development), alongside the business workflow automation that is available today under Software & IT Services.
categories.custom_text: We build customized AI agents, intelligent assistants and automated workflows designed to reduce manual work, improve productivity and streamline business operations across diverse industries.
